attributes.board_name: Wisconsin Board of Nursing (Department of Safety and Professional Services)

rules.notes: No CE required for this license. Renewal requires the DWD nursing workforce survey and reporting the primary state of residence; $25 late fee after expiry. Deadline as listed on the DSPS renewal-date page.
